integrity: The proof is analytic: Parseval isolates the unique resonant cross term, strict pair balancing reduces the sharp norm to a one-variable cubic, and the exact algebraic maximizer is solved in closed form. The bundled checker corroborates the concrete support and exact algebra but is not used as an infinite or literature claim.
scientific_limitations: The theorem requires exactly one nontrivial size-three multiset collision, of balanced multiplicity type \(2+1=1+2\). Multiple collisions or the distinct \(2+1=3\) defect type are not covered.
title: Sharp sixth-moment norm for one balanced triple-sum defect
